QUOTE: "Tiers 3 and 4 always accumulate." and "`resolved = (tier1 or tier2 or tier5) ∪ tier3 ∪ tier4`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer shows tiers 3 and 4 both accumulate in the formula. It never says they combine identically, that the distinction between them is deliberately inert, or that the load-bearing line is fact versus guess.
